findings.title: Original review owner can be supplied from a different historical source association
findings.actual: All three private mutants return a genuine verified capability for a changed owner while preserving the original reviewed goal UUID, text and image bytes. The original review supplies no owner assertion; any chosen source file/commit containing the goal currently satisfies the association check.
findings.requiredBoundary: Bind the two closed profiles to their actual authoritative canonical owner identities and source paths, or to an externally accepted specific original owner association. Source/review commit equality alone is insufficient: 01C moves unchanged review/input/asset refs to the later owner source commit.
findings.prohibitedShortcut: Do not replace original review text with current source text or treat arbitrary historical drafts as authoritative owner sources.

findings.title: Local Git replace refs can change the content behind an externally accepted commit
findings.actual: A manipulated original review description is rejected without a replacement ref, then accepted with a private git replace of the externally fixed base commit. The receipt and current context can claim a newly added never-reviewed competency under that external commit value.
findings.requiredBoundary: Disable Git replacement objects consistently for every original object read, tree lookup, commit check and ancestry check. Repeat the same private counterexample after the change.
findings.scope: This is a normal local Git replacement feature, reproduced only in a private RAM repository; no host Git refs or original files were edited.
